# Dictionary licenses

<!-- Generated by dictionaries/pages.py from dictionaries/catalog, dictionaries/sources.json and dictionaries/policy.json; do not edit. -->

The udlex code is MIT. The dictionary packages are data with their own licenses,
which follow from the sources they were built from. The rules are in
[`dictionaries/README.md`](dictionaries/README.md#licenses); this page lists what
they gave for release v1.0.0.

## How a package gets its license

- Every table keeps the license of its source. The corpus tables (`exact`,
  `lower`, `rules`, `entities`) are learned from the anchor treebank and carry
  its license. Each row of the `external` table comes from exactly one
  dictionary and carries that dictionary's license.
- A package with a non-commercial part is named `udlex-dict-<iso>-nc` and is
  released as a whole under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Otherwise the package takes the
  strictest license of its parts.
- Each wheel and archive holds the treebank README and LICENSE, a `NOTICE` with
  the attribution of every input, and `SOURCES.json`. Like spaCy's `meta.json`,
  `SOURCES.json` lists each source with name, URL, version, author and SPDX
  license, and the files it fills. The same metadata for every package is in
  [`dictionaries/catalog/DICTIONARIES.json`](dictionaries/catalog/DICTIONARIES.json).

If you redistribute a package, keep its `NOTICE` and `SOURCES.json` and follow
its license.

## Package licenses

| License | Packages |
| --- | ---: |
| CC-BY-SA-4.0 | 182 |
| CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 | 39 |
| CC-BY-SA-3.0 | 2 |
| CC-BY-4.0 | 1 |

Non-commercial packages (39): `udlex-dict-arb-nc`, `udlex-dict-bul-nc`, `udlex-dict-ces-nc`, `udlex-dict-che-nc`, `udlex-dict-chu-nc`, `udlex-dict-ctn-nc`, `udlex-dict-dar-nc`, `udlex-dict-ell-nc`, `udlex-dict-eng-nc`, `udlex-dict-est-nc`, `udlex-dict-eus-nc`, `udlex-dict-frm-nc`, `udlex-dict-fro-nc`, `udlex-dict-glg-nc`, `udlex-dict-got-nc`, `udlex-dict-grc-nc`, `udlex-dict-gun-nc`, `udlex-dict-hbo-nc`, `udlex-dict-heb-nc`, `udlex-dict-hin-nc`, `udlex-dict-hun-nc`, `udlex-dict-ita-nc`, `udlex-dict-kbc-nc`, `udlex-dict-lat-nc`, `udlex-dict-lzh-nc`, `udlex-dict-naq-nc`, `udlex-dict-nld-nc`, `udlex-dict-oci-nc`, `udlex-dict-pol-nc`, `udlex-dict-qpm-nc`, `udlex-dict-qtd-nc`, `udlex-dict-ruc-nc`, `udlex-dict-sjo-nc`, `udlex-dict-srd-nc`, `udlex-dict-tam-nc`, `udlex-dict-ukr-nc`, `udlex-dict-urd-nc`, `udlex-dict-xcl-nc`, `udlex-dict-yrl-nc`.

Of these, 13 also carry `requires_license_review`: the treebank's
README and LICENSE disagree, or [`policy.json`](dictionaries/policy.json) lists
the treebank for review: `ctn`, `frm`, `fro`, `gun`, `hbo`, `lzh`, `naq`, `nld`, `oci`, `qtd`, `ruc`, `sjo`, `srd`.

Packages whose treebank states extra conditions:

- `udlex-dict-deu` (CC-BY-SA-4.0): The UD_German-HDT README states that Heise gave permission to distribute the text for academic use; the annotations are under a Creative Commons share-alike license.
- `udlex-dict-ita-nc` (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0): The UD_Italian-ISDT LICENSE.txt states that the data are released for research purposes only and asks publications to cite the treebank.
- `udlex-dict-lij` (CC-BY-SA-4.0): UD_Ligurian-GLT is distributed under the Computational Use of Data Agreement (C-UDA 1.0).

Per-package licenses are also listed in [docs/languages.md](docs/languages.md).

## Left out

Sources with a copyleft or unclear license are not used
(`excluded_license_classes` in [`policy.json`](dictionaries/policy.json)):

| Source | License | Class |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `freeling-ca` | AGPL-3.0-or-later | copyleft |
| `freeling-cy` | GPL-3.0-or-later | copyleft |
| `freeling-en` | AGPL-3.0-or-later | copyleft |
| `freeling-es` | LicenseRef-LGPL-LR | copyleft |
| `freeling-fr` | LicenseRef-LGPL-LR | copyleft |
| `freeling-nb` | GPL-3.0-or-later | copyleft |
| `freeling-pt` | GPL-3.0-only | copyleft |
| `freeling-ru` | AGPL-3.0-or-later | copyleft |

Also left out for some languages, because their part of a source has another
license: `unimorph` for ckb (LicenseRef-LGPL-LR); `unimorph` for eus (no license); `unimorph` for kmr (LicenseRef-LGPL-LR). Excluded by policy: `dict-uk`, `simplemma`, `slavicner`, `spacy-lookups-unlicensed`, `unimorph` for eus, hsb, kmr, kor, sah, slk.
